g.title: raft/node.go & raft/wal: Pure zero-I/O state machine with segmented CRC32C WAL and FlushedIndex coupling

sim.Rand: Stream-isolated xoshiro256** PRNG seeded via SHA-256 domain separation
sim.Scheduler: Single-threaded min-heap priority queue ordered by (timeNs, seq)
sim.Transport: Switches seamlessly between SimNet chaos matrix and real TCP sockets
vfs.FS: Swaps between POSIX OSFS and crashable 512B sector-tearing SimFS
